properties.Description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

identity.Description: The managed service identities assigned to this resource.

location.Description: The geo-location where the resource lives

systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

scope.Description: The scope to apply for configuration.

policyInitiatives.Description: The policy initiatives selected for the sovereign view.

regulatoryDocumentName.Description: Stable regulatory-document key selected when this Sovereign View was created.

provisioningState.Description: The status of a user-initiated, control-plane operation on the sovereign view resource type.

isWorkload.Description: Indicates whether the Sovereign View is considered a workload.

id.Description: The resource identifier of the management group.

name.Description: The management group name. This is a purely client side label that the service does not validate, normalize, or use for any lookup.
The subscription name. This is a purely client side label that the service does not validate, normalize, or use for any lookup.

policyInitiativeId.Description: The fully qualified id of the policy initiative.

dimension.Description: The compliance dimension associated with the policy initiative.

policyAssignmentIds.Description: The resource identifiers of existing policy assignments association with the policy initiative and scopes in the sovereign view.

policyVersion.Description: The version of the policy initiative.

dataResidency.Description: Settings for the Data Residency dimension.

resourceEvaluationScope.Description: The resource scope evaluated for the Data Residency dimension.

parameters.Description: Parameters used by the Data Residency evaluation.

allowedLocations.Description: Azure regions in which the resource and its linked resources are allowed to reside.

principalId.Description: The service principal ID of the system assigned identity. This property will only be provided for a system assigned identity.

tenantId.Description: The tenant ID of the system assigned identity. This property will only be provided for a system assigned identity.

type.Description: Type of managed service identity (either system assigned, or none).

createdBy.Description: The identity that created the resource.

createdByType.Description: The type of identity that created the resource.

lastModifiedBy.Description: The identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedByType.Description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedAt.Description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)
